highlights: Soft blur effects (blur-xl, blur-[120px]) on dark backgrounds for ambient glow (opacity 0.15 dark theme)
Noise/grain texture overlay on dark shader canvas (70px tile, mix-blend-mode: multiply, opacity 0.42)
Radial glow on gray-1000 background with large blur radius for ambient lighting effects
Linear gradient masks for fade effects (top to bottom, left to right) on scrollable content
Animated shimmer effects with color-mix for loading states
Drop shadow rings: 0 0 0 1px borders for subtle elevation
Passport glow animation: multicolor vertical gradient with rotating ellipse blur effect
Box shadows with soft blur: shadow-border, shadow-tooltip patterns
Semi-transparent overlays (gray-alpha-200, gray-alpha-400) for hover states and borders
